4 protocols:
Sampling Protocol - Grab sampling: (Green sea urchins collected at depths between 1 and 10 m using nets either attached to a pole or dragged across the sea floor from a boat, put into polyethylene bags and frozen)
Sampling Protocol - Point sampling: (Blue mussels (c. 10 individual per site) and seaweed collected from shore at low tide. For seaweed, the fresh growth tips were cut from the rest of the plants using stainless steel scissors)
Sampling Protocol - Grab sampling: (Sea bottom sediment collected using an Ekman grab sampler and the upper c. 5-cm layer sampled from three different spots and pooled into one bag)
Sampling Protocol - DGT: (Measurements of labile dissolved metal concentration in seawater using DGT sampling devices (Diffusive Gradients in Thin films) suspended in the water column c. 3 m above the bottom and deployed from 2 to 11 August 2017)
